description.zh:
是否自动删除。取值：

- true：是。如果订阅该Queue的最后一个消费端取消订阅后，那么该Queue将会自动删除。
- false：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically delete the queue. Valid values:

*   true: The queue is automatically deleted. After the last consumer unsubscribes from the queue, the queue is automatically deleted.
*   false: The queue is not automatically deleted.

description.zh:
Queue的自动过期时间。如果Queue在指定时间内没有被访问，则会被自动删除。

单位为毫秒。
> 该参数对应的功能需要开通后才能使用。如需使用，请<props="china">[提交工单](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex)</props><props="intl">[提交工单](https://ticket-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)</props>开通。
description.en:
The validity period after which the queue is automatically deleted. If the queue is not accessed within the specified period of time, the queue is automatically deleted.

Unit: milliseconds.

>  You can use the feature that corresponds to this parameter only after you enable the feature. To enable the feature, [submit a ticket](https://ticket-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex).

description.zh:
死信Exchange。该类Exchange是用来接收被拒绝的消息。

如果消费端拒绝一个不重新发送的消息，那么消息队列RabbitMQ版将会把消息路由到指定的死信Exchange，该Exchange再将消息路由到绑定的Queue进行存储。
description.en:
The dead-letter exchange. A dead-letter exchange is used to receive rejected messages.

If a consumer rejects a message that cannot be redelivered, ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ routes the message to the specified dead-letter exchange. Then, the dead-letter exchange routes the message to the queue that is bound to the dead-letter exchange for storage.

description.zh:
死信Routing Key。
只能包含字⺟、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、at符号（@），⻓度限制1~255字符。
description.en: The dead-letter routing key. The key must be 1 to 255 characters in length, and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (\_), periods (.), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), and at signs (@).

description.zh:
是否为排他性Exchange。取值：

- true：是。只能被声明该排他性Exchange的Connection使用。该Connection断开后该排他性Exchange自动删除。
- false：否。
description.en:
Specifies whether the exchange is an exclusive exchange. Valid values:

*   true: The exchange is an exclusive exchange. Only the connection that declares the exclusive exchange can use the exclusive exchange. After the connection is closed, the exclusive exchange is automatically deleted.
*   false: The exchange is not an exclusive exchange.

description.zh: 待创建Queue所属的云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance on which you want to create a queue.

description.zh:
当前版本不支持该参数。

Queue中消息的最大数量。如果超出该数量，则先到达该Queue的消息将会被删除。
description.en:
This parameter is unavailable in the current version of ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ.

The maximum number of messages that can be stored in the queue. If this threshold is exceeded, the earliest stored messages in the queue are deleted.

description.zh:
队列优先级，推荐取值范围（1~10）。
> 该参数为消息优先级对应参数，仅独享实例支持，开通消息优先级功能后才能使用。如需使用，请<props="china">[提交工单](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/createIndex)</props><props="intl">[提交工单](https://ticket-intl.console.aliyun.com/#/ticket/createIndex)</props>开通。
description.en: Queue priorities are not supported. The value does not affect the call or return results.

description.zh:
消息在Queue中的有效期。

- 某条消息在Queue中的留存时间超过配置的消息存活时间时，则该消息过期。

- 消息存活时间的值必须为非负整型数，最大为1天。单位为毫秒。例如，某条消息的存活时间的值是1000，则代表该消息最多会在Queue中存活1秒。
description.en:
The message time to live (TTL) of the queue.

*   If the retention period of a message in the queue exceeds the message TTL of the queue, the message expires.
*   The message TTL must be set to a non-negative integer. The maximum message TTL is one day. Unit: milliseconds. For example, if the message TTL is 1,000 milliseconds, the message can be retained for up to 1 second in the queue.

description.zh:
待创建的Queue的名称。

- Queue名称只能包含字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、at符号（@），长度限制1~255字符。

- Queue创建后，名称无法修改，只能删除后重建。
description.en:
The name of the queue that you want to create.

*   The name must be 1 to 255 characters in length, and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (\_), periods (.), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), and at signs (@).
*   After the queue is created, you cannot change the name of the queue. If you want to change the name of the queue, delete the queue and create another queue.

description.zh:
待创建Queue所属的Vhost名称。
只能包含字⺟、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、at符号（@），⻓度限制1~255字符。
description.en: The name of the vhost to which the queue that you want to create belongs. The name must be 1 to 255 characters in length, and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (\_), periods (.), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), and at signs (@).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun amqp-open create-queue --instance-id amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu000 --virtual-host test --queue-name DemoQueue --auto-delete-state false --exclusive-state false --message-ttl 1000 --auto-expire-state 10000 --max-length 1000 --dead-letter-exchange DLExchange --dead-letter-routing-key test.dl --maximum-priority 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun amqp-open CreateQueue --region cn-hangzhou --DeadLetterExchange DLExchange --MaximumPriority 10 --InstanceId 'amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu000' --ExclusiveState false --DeadLetterRoutingKey 'test.dl' --VirtualHost test --AutoDeleteState false --MaxLength 1000 --QueueName DemoQueue --MessageTTL 1000 --AutoExpireState 10000
